theorem joint_buffered_data_bound (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M]
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (η : Character) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (Q : Ideal O)
    (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)}) (hQM : Q ≤ M) (hQη₀ : ∀ j, Q ≤ (η₀ j).modulus)
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (A B : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < A j)
    (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (A j) (B j)) (hV : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V j))
    (Rwidth dmax τ ε e κ ηaux σmin σmax loss : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hloss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ loss)
    (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (hprofile : ∀ k, 0 ≤ profileBound k) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ Z d : ℝ, 1 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ (w : NonzeroElement)
        (R : JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
      jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) R hR
        p.lower p.upper p.height w →
      ∀ D : JointBufferedProductData η w Slot n profileBound p.lower e,
      D.Admissible M H hH η₀ A B Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height →
      ‖D.value M H η₀ V B Z d‖^2 ≤ C*(Z^d)^((2*p.lower-1)*D.length+loss)
title: joint_buffered_data_bound

    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {β : α → Type*}
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (η : Character) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Bprofile : Slot → ℝ)
    (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (a e Z d : ℝ)
    (labels : Finset α) (w : α → NonzeroElement) (fiber : (v : α) → Finset (β v))
    (weight value : (v : α) → β v → ℝ) (B E Csrc : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hCsrc : 0 ≤ Csrc)
    (gate : (v : α) → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e →
      SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e → Prop)
    (hweight : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, 0 ≤ weight v b)
    (hvalue : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, 0 ≤ value v b)
    (hmass : ∀ v ∈ labels, (∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b) ≤ B)
    (hdata : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v,
      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e,
        value v b ≤ Csrc*(‖DL.value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖*‖DR.value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ∧
        gate v DL DR)

      (∀ v ∈ S, gate v (FL v) (FR v)) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, ‖(FL v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
        ‖(FR v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ≤ E) :
    (∑ v ∈ labels, ∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b*value v b) ≤ B*(Csrc*E)

statement:
theorem admissible_rebin_of_two_stage
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (A B : Slot → ℝ)
    (Rwidth τ ν ηaux σmin σmax dmin : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hgap : ν < τ) (hηaux : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hheight : 4*τ < dmin*ηaux) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ d : ℝ, dmin ≤ d → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ I →
    ∀ D : JointBufferedProductData η w Slot n profileBound a e,
    ∀ t v₁ v₂ w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂ : ℝ, ∀ v : Slot → ℝ,
    |t| ≤ Z^ν → |v₁| ≤ Z^ν → |v₂| ≤ Z^ν → (∀ j, |v j| ≤ Z^ν) →
    |w₁| ≤ Z^ν → |θ₁| ≤ Z^ν → |w₂| ≤ Z^ν → |θ₂| ≤ Z^ν →
    D.plain₁.freq = twoStageFrequency t v₁ w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂ →

statement:
theorem survivingBufferedData_remove_short {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (A B : Slot → ℝ) (lo hi : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ j, 0 < A j) (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (A j) (B j))
    (hV : ∀ j, Continuous (V j)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement)
      (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (a e : ℝ)
      (η₀ : Slot → Character) (P : Slot → ℝ) (Z d : ℝ)
      (D : SurvivingBufferedData η w Slot
        (fun S => orders (S ∩ largePrimeSlots A B P)) profileBound a e),
      (∀ j : D.slots, (Z^d)^(D.data.r j) = P j.val) →
      (∀ j ∈ D.slots, 1 ≤ P j) →
      (∀ j : D.slots, lo ≤ D.data.σ j ∧ D.data.σ j ≤ hi) →
      ‖D.value M H η₀ V B Z d‖ ≤
        C*‖(D.restrictSlots (largePrimeSlots A B P)).value M H η₀ V B Z d‖
title: survivingBufferedData_remove_short

    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ Z ∧

      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧ primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →

      (∀ v ∈ S, ((jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (v.row (unit v))).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ Z^(16*B+1)

statement:
theorem actual_coherent_exceptional_counted_values
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (wlo whi : ℝ) (hwlo : 0 < wlo) (hwhi : 0 ≤ whi) (lo hi : ι → ℝ)
    (ε δ θ B Lbound : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ Lbound) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ Sprofile : Finset (ℕ×ℕ), (0,0) ∈ Sprofile ∧
    ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ ⊤ → Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (src : Input ι) (profile : Profiles wlo whi),
    (∀ i, src.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i, src.hi i = hi i) → (∀ i, 1 ≤ src.P i) →
    src.W₁ = profile.profile 0 → src.W₂ = profile.profile 1 →
    ∀ (R seed C₁ L₁ : Ideal O) (hC₁ : Supported C₁), R ≠ 0 → seed ∣ C₁ →
    ∀ p : ActiveLabel (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
      (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁),
    ∀ (η : Character) (U : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2))
      (family : RayCharacter → Character),
    Family η p.val.1 p.val.2 (lowActiveLeftSupported p) (lowActiveRightSupported p) U family →
    ∀ (χL χR : RayCharacter) (vL vR HL HR r : ℝ), 0 < HL → 0 < HR →
    Z^r ≤ src.X₁ → Z^r ≤ src.X₂ → Z^r ≤ src.Y₁ → Z^r ≤ src.Y₂ →
    idealCoeff η p.val.1 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ m : O, m ≠ 0 → goodLambda ∣ m → (2 : O) ∣ m →
    ∀ rows : Finset O, (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ rows, CenteredExceptionalProfile.FixedInducingRow (childCharacter η χL) Q m
      (commonFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2*nonunitFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2 U) z) →
    ∀ Cr rowExponent : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cr →
    (∀ z ∈ rows, ((Ideal.span {z}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Cr*Z^rowExponent) →
    (∀ z ∈ rows, ((family χL).modulus.absNorm*(Ideal.span {fixedBadMask}).absNorm*
      (Ideal.span {(72:O)}).absNorm*(R.absNorm*(C₁*p.val.1).absNorm)*(Ideal.span {z}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
    (∀ z ∈ rows, ((reflected (family χR)).modulus.absNorm*(Ideal.span {fixedBadMask}).absNorm*
      (Ideal.span {(72:O)}).absNorm*(R.absNorm*(C₁*p.val.2).absNorm)*(Ideal.span {z}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
    ∀ Ds : Finset (Ideal O),
    (∀ L ∈ Ds, (moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Lbound) →
    commonSecondValuePair src R seed C₁ L₁ hC₁ p η U χL χR vL vR HL HR Ds rows ≤
      (volume src.toData/Real.sqrt (HL*HR))*
        (K*(768*(6:ℝ)^(normalizedFactors Q).toFinset.card*Cr^(1/6:ℝ))*
          Z^((rowExponent-4*Real.logb Z ((forcingIdeal (fun P : CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2 => P.val)
            (leftExponent p.val.1 p.val.2) (rightExponent p.val.1 p.val.2)
            (nonunitPartitionSet p.val.1 p.val.2 U)).absNorm : ℝ))/6+2*ε+δ-max (max (r-Real.logb Z ((C₁*p.val.1).absNorm : ℝ)) 0)
          (max (r-Real.logb Z ((C₁*p.val.2).absNorm : ℝ)) 0))*
          (((C₁*p.val.1).absNorm : ℝ)*(C₁*p.val.2).absNorm)^θ*
          (profileMass Sprofile (withHeight src (family χL) vL).toData
            (withHeight src (reflected (family χR)) vR).toData profile profile J*
              frozenProfile src*frozenProfile src/
                (((C₁*p.val.1).absNorm : ℝ)*(C₁*p.val.2).absNorm)))
title: actual_coherent_exceptional_counted_values

statement:
theorem actual_common_source_tail_normalized (Csource B ξ saving : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∃ SΦ : Finset (ℕ×ℕ), ∃ Cbound : ℝ, 0 < Cbound ∧
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (s : Input ι) (R seed C L : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C), L ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (B₁ B₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ B₁ → 0 ≤ B₂ → s.W₁ 0 = 0 → s.W₂ 0 = 0 →
      (∀ x, ‖s.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) → (∀ x, ‖s.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂) →
      0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Csource*volume s.toData → volume s.toData ≤ Z^B →
      (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B →
    ∀ (η : Character) (t : ℝ) (Φ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K Tsec P : ℝ),
      0 < K → K ≤ Z^B → 1 ≤ P → Tsec ≤ Z^B →
      (sourceRadius s/(C.absNorm : ℝ))^2/K ≤ Tsec →
      ‖secondDiscardedEnergy η t (commonSecondColumns (original s R seed) C hC)
        (commonSecondBeta (original s R seed) C L) Φ K Tsec Z ξ‖ / (volume s.toData*P) ≤
      (Cbound*(originalAbsoluteProfile s B₁ B₂)^2*
        SΦ.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℂ) Φ)*Z^(-saving)/(L.absNorm : ℝ)

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
    ∀ (src : Input ι), (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) → src.upper ≤ upper →

    ∀ (R seed : Ideal O), Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 →

statement:
theorem exists_input_common_error_families
    (P : Finset (Ideal O)) (hP : ∀ Q ∈ P, Prime Q)
    (hbad : ∀ Q ∈ P, Q ∉ fixedBadPrimes)
    (Z sigma b eta delta reserve : ℝ) (hZ : 1 < Z) (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsep : b*Z^eta < Z^(sigma/6))
    (hpl : ∀ Q ∈ P, Z^(sigma/6) ≤ (Q.absNorm : ℝ))
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hreserve : 2 ≤ Z^reserve) :
    ∃ τ : Character → elementPool P → Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Character,
      (∀ η (p : elementPool P) i χ, ((τ η p i χ).modulus.absNorm : ℝ) ≤
        radicalBound (childCharacter η χ) fixedBadMask p.val (errorMovingExponent (errorIndex i))) ∧
      ∀ (s : Input ι), (∀ i, Function.support (s.W i) ⊆ Set.Iic b) →
      ∀ (z : ι → ℝ), (∀ i, z i ≤ eta) → (∀ i, s.P i = Z^(z i)) →
      ∀ (R seed : Ideal O) (d K₀ c : ℝ) (j : ℤ),
        Real.logb Z (dyadicScale j) ≤ K₀+delta →
        (∑ p ∈ elementPool P, ∑ h ∈ (dyadRows j).filter (fun h => eligible R seed h p),
          errorEnergy Finset.univ (sourceGenerator (original s R seed).columns)
            (sourceGenerator_supported (original s R seed).columns)
            ((original s R seed).coefficient s.η fixedBadMask s.t (volume s)) h p) ≤
          ∑ p : elementPool P,
            firstExtractedErrors s R seed Z d K₀ c sigma delta reserve p (τ s.η p)
title: exists_input_common_error_families

statement:
theorem actual_common_retained_admissible
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (s : Input ι) (C R : Ideal O) (B : actualAllocations s.pools C)
        (source : Character) (A z : O) (t : ℝ)
        (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset
          (CenteredMomentCommonProfile.liveIndices B.val ⊕ Fin 2))) (branch : Bool)
        (Z d : ℝ) (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ)
        (alo bhi : ι → ℝ) (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.W₁ = W₁ → s.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, s.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (R*C)) A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.P i ∧ s.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (∀ i : liveIndices D allocation,
        2*(|Real.log (alo i.val.val)|+|Real.log (bhi i.val.val)|)+1 ≤ Real.log (s.P i.val.val)) →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
        D allocation branch z ≠ 0 →
      ∃ data : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        data.slots = embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding (commonSlotEmbedding s C B) D allocation) ∧
        ‖secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
          D allocation branch z‖ = ‖data.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*data.length ≤ Real.logb Z (secondCommonVolume s C B)-
          Real.logb Z (formalReductionFactor D allocation (fun i => s.P i.val))+
          Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        data.Admissible M H hH η₀ alo bhi Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T
title: actual_common_retained_admissible

statement:
theorem actual_joint_dictionary_density (η : Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : Q ≤ η.modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loss : ℝ) (hlosspos : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → ∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ F : Finset FreeRow,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rowNorm u ≤ Y ∧ jointNaturalZeroBin η Q hQ72
          p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss)) ∧
      (∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        ∀ R : Finset ProbePhysical.NonzeroFrequency,
        (∀ u ∈ R, rawFrequencyNorm u ≤ Y ∧ jointNaturalZeroBin η Q hQ72
          p.lower p.upper p.height u) →
        (R.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss))
title: actual_joint_dictionary_density

theorem actual_first_allocated_exceptional_sum
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (wlo whi : ℝ) (hwlo : 0 < wlo) (hwhi : 0 ≤ whi)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (Bcap Bfirst Lfirst Crfirst : ℝ)
    (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hBfirst : 0 ≤ Bfirst) (hLfirst : 0 ≤ Lfirst) (hCrfirst : 0 < Crfirst) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), (0,0) ∈ S ∧
      ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ ⊤ → Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ Cfixed : ℝ, 0 < Cfixed ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (s : Input Slot) (p₀ : Profiles wlo whi),
      (∀ i, s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i, s.hi i = hi i) →
      s.W₁ = p₀.profile 0 → s.W₂ = p₀.profile 1 → s.upper ≤ b →
      ∀ R seed : Ideal O, Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 → s.W₁ 0 = 0 → s.W₂ 0 = 0 →
      0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Z^Bfirst →
      ∀ (m A : O) (t : ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
        (K a₁ a₂ win M heightCap seedFloor : ℝ),
      0 < K → 0 < a₁ → 0 < a₂ → 0 ≤ heightCap → 0 < seedFloor →
      (∀ y, s.W₁ y ≠ 0 → a₁ ≤ y) → (∀ y, s.W₂ y ≠ 0 → a₂ ≤ y) →
      (∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ win) →
      1 ≤ M → M ≤ Real.logb Z K+Real.logb Z (s.η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z fixedPresentationCost →
      Real.logb Z (CenteredMomentAmplificationChildInput.volume s) ≤ (883/1000)*M →
      Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₂ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₂ →
      ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,
      (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Crfirst*Z^Lfirst) →
      ∀ (ξ₁ ξ₂ : RayCharacter) (F : Families s R seed ξ₁ ξ₂),
      ∀ runs : (p : Labels s R seed) → (E : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2)) →
        Blocks (effectiveScale p.val.1 p.val.2 E K) (radius p E)
          (sourceRadius s/p.val.1.absNorm) (sourceRadius s/p.val.2.absNorm) → Fin 2 → MainExceptionalRun,
      (∀ (p : Labels s R seed) (E : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2)),
        E ∈ CenteredMomentFirstDiscardedEnergy.inactiveSubsets p.val.1 p.val.2 → ∀ n,
        (runs p E n 0).mask = R ∧ (runs p E n 1).mask = R ∧
        (runs p E n 0).Admissible s p.val.1 p.val.2 (F p E).left Z Bcap Bfirst heightCap seedFloor ∧
        (runs p E n 1).Admissible s p.val.2 p.val.1 (F p E).right Z Bcap Bfirst heightCap seedFloor) →
      (∑ p : Labels s R seed,
        ∑ E ∈ CenteredMomentFirstDiscardedEnergy.inactiveSubsets p.val.1 p.val.2,
        ∑ n : Blocks (effectiveScale p.val.1 p.val.2 E K) (radius p E)
          (sourceRadius s/p.val.1.absNorm) (sourceRadius s/p.val.2.absNorm),
          allowanceWeight s R seed m A t W V K (radius p E) Z p E (F p E).left (F p E).right n *
            (Real.sqrt ((runs p E n 0).normalizedValue s p.val.1 p.val.2 E (F p E).left K b Z Q)*
             Real.sqrt ((runs p E n 1).normalizedValue s p.val.2 p.val.1
               (swapSubset p.val.1 p.val.2 E) (F p E).right K b Z Q))) ≤
      Cfixed*p₀.control S^2*(1+heightCap)^(2*J)*mass s^6*
        ((Real.exp win/((∏ i,s.lo i)*a₁*a₂))*fixedPresentationCost*K*(s.η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ))*
          Z^(-7/100 : ℝ)/((seed.absNorm : ℝ)*seedFloor)

    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) :
    ∃ degree : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O),
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Ncap → (∀ i, s.M i ≤ F) → s.upper ≤ U → s.b₁ ≤ b₁ → s.b₂ ≤ b₂ →

theorem eventually_actual_first_source_coarse_powers
    (N : ℕ) (F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂ D B L Cr A J : ℝ)
    (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O),
    Fintype.card ι ≤ N → (∀ i, s.M i ≤ F) → s.upper ≤ U → s.b₁ ≤ b₁ → s.b₂ ≤ b₂ →
    s.W₁ 0 = 0 → s.W₂ 0 = 0 →
    (∀ x, ‖s.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) → (∀ x, ‖s.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂) →
    0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Z^B → volume s.toData ≤ Z^A →
    ∀ (K : ℝ), 0 < K →
    ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,
    (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Cr*Z^L) →
    ∀ (W : FirstSourceOuterIndex s R seed K radius → 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
      (H : FirstSourceOuterIndex s R seed K radius → ℝ),
    (∀ i, 0 < H i) → (∀ i, H i ≤ Z^J) →
    (∀ i, QuadraticInitialBound.diagonalControl (W i) ≤ D) →
    ∀ p : Labels s R seed,
    (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels Finset.univ (firstSourceOuterLabel s R seed K radius),
      ((firstSourceOuterLabel s R seed K radius k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftCoarse (W k.1) (H k.1)) ≤
      (volume s.toData/(p.val.1.absNorm : ℝ))*
        (((Fintype.card RayCharacter : ℝ)^2*128*D*
          (firstAbsoluteProfileConstant N F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂)^2)*Z^(J+6*B+A+2)) ∧
    (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels Finset.univ (firstSourceOuterLabel s R seed K radius),
      ((firstSourceOuterLabel s R seed K radius k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightCoarse (W k.1) (H k.1)) ≤
      (volume s.toData/(p.val.2.absNorm : ℝ))*
        (((Fintype.card RayCharacter : ℝ)^2*128*D*
          (firstAbsoluteProfileConstant N F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂)^2)*Z^(J+6*B+A+2))

statement:
theorem actual_local_natural_moment_all_heights
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask ε : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hsSlot : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) :
    ∃ mesh : ℝ, 0 < mesh ∧ mesh ≤ lowLocalMesh ∧
    ∀ (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O), Q ≤ M →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus →
    ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)),
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ mesh) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z X₁+Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)
title: actual_local_natural_moment_all_heights

theorem first_source_coarse_powers {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (N : ℕ) (F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂ D : ℝ)
    (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O) (q : FirstJointLabel ι)
    (hdata : q.data = original s R seed)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K Z A B J : ℝ) (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hJ : 0 ≤ J)
    (hN : Fintype.card ι ≤ N) (hF : ∀ i, s.M i ≤ F)
    (hU : s.upper ≤ U) (hb₁ : s.b₁ ≤ b₁) (hb₂ : s.b₂ ≤ b₂)

    (hbound₁ : ∀ x, ‖s.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) (hbound₂ : ∀ x, ‖s.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hKcap : K ≤ Z^J) (hW : QuadraticInitialBound.diagonalControl W ≤ D)
    (hsource : sourceRadius s ≤ Z^B) (hvolume : volume s.toData ≤ Z^A) :

statement:
theorem eventually_first_fourier_targets_of_annular (ν η : ℝ) (hgap : ν < η) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ {Λ Slot : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype Slot]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (q : Λ → FirstJointLabel Slot) (ref : FirstJointLabel Slot)
      (t H : Λ → ℝ) (V A Ch : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ labels,|t i| ≤ Z^ν) →
      (∀ u : Bool → ((i : Λ) × (q i).SourceIndex) → ℝ,
        (∀ left,∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,|u left k| ≤ Z^η) →
        ∀ left,
          (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
            ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (u left k) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/((ref.sideCommon left).absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.sideTargetWidth left Z A))) →
      ∀ θ w : ℝ,‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
          ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/(ref.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.leftTargetWidth Z A)) ∧
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
          ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/(ref.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.rightTargetWidth Z A))
title: eventually_first_fourier_targets_of_annular

statement:
theorem uniform_first_full_sector_sum (B e : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (he : 0 < e) :
    ∃ Ccells : ℝ, 0 < Ccells ∧
    ∀ {Row Slot : Type*} [DecidableEq Row] [Fintype Slot]
      (labels : Finset Row) (q : Row → FirstJointLabel Slot) (Z : ℝ), 1 < Z →
      (∀ u ∈ labels,(q u).C.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ) ∧ (q u).D.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (f : Row → ℝ) (H : ℝ), 0 ≤ H →
      (∀ (cell : Finset Row),cell ⊆ labels → ∀ ref ∈ cell,
        (∀ u ∈ cell,∀ j,|(q u).fullWidthCoordinates Z j-(q ref).fullWidthCoordinates Z j| < e) →
        (∀ u ∈ cell,(q ref).activeWidth Z/2+(q ref).punctureWidth Z ≤
          (q u).activeWidth Z/2+(q u).punctureWidth Z) →
        (∑ u ∈ cell,f u) ≤ H) →
      (∑ u ∈ labels,f u) ≤ Ccells*H
title: uniform_first_full_sector_sum

statement:
theorem actual_natural_coarse_energy
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (hW : Continuous W) (aslot bslot lo hi a b : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (p : Profiles a b) (Φ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (Z Bmask bΦ : ℝ),1 < Z →
      ∀ (s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ),s.rowWidth=1 → s.radial.profile=Φ →
      ∀ (η₀ : Character) (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ)
        (hσ : ∀ i,σ i∈Set.Icc lo hi) (t X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0< X₁) (hX₂ : 0< X₂),
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 → (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i=> CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I=> idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight W (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i=> Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤ C*Z^(2:ℝ)
title: actual_natural_coarse_energy

theorem block_eq_kernel_children (s : FirstJointLabel ι) (t : ℝ)
    (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ) (K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hK₀ : 0 < K₀) (hH₀ : 0 < H₀) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀) :
    block s.parent (fixedBadMask * idealGenerator s.data.R) 1 t s.data.columns s.data.beta
      s.C s.D s.hC s.hD s.E rows W V K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ =
    scalar s.C s.D s.hC s.E K A₀ B₀ *
      ∑ L ∈ s.projectors, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) *
        ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ ξ : RayCharacter, pairCoeff firstPhaseTable χ ξ *
          (s.childLabel L χ ξ).kernelBlock t rows W V (K₀ * H₀ / (A₀ * B₀))
            (Real.log ((K / ‖eisEmbedding s.puncture‖ ^ 2 /
              ‖eisEmbedding (activeConductor s.C s.D)‖ ^ 2) / K₀))
            (fun z => Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀)) A₀ B₀
            (fun z => star (s.activeRow z) * s.activeRow s.puncture)

theorem joint_first_blocks_from_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ) (η : Λ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i : (s l).SourceIndex,
        ‖η l * (s l).sourceWeight (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l) i‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ E₁ → 0 ≤ E₂ →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₁ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₂ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) * η l *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) rows W V (K l) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ ≤
          C * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂)

    (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ) (K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : ℝ)

    s.sourceBlock t rows W V K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ =
      ∑ i : s.SourceIndex, s.sourceWeight K A₀ B₀ i *
        (s.sourceChild i).kernelBlock t rows W V (K₀ * H₀ / (A₀ * B₀))
          (s.sourceRowLog K K₀) (fun z => Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀))
          A₀ B₀ s.sourcePhase

statement:
theorem joint_first_blocks_from_local_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay : ℕ) (ν B lower : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (target₁ target₂ Z Ch₁ Ch₂ Ct₁ Ct₂ : ℝ),
      lower ≤ target₁ → lower ≤ target₂ → 1 ≤ Z →
      0 ≤ Ch₁ → 0 ≤ Ch₂ → 0 ≤ Ct₁ → 0 ≤ Ct₂ →
      ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)

    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z M A δ a window : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 < a →
      ∀ (t K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*A₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.C.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.D.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.activeWidth Z ≤ (s l).activeWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.punctureWidth Z ≤ (s l).punctureWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (Z^M) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →

        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy

            (((Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*Z^(q.leftTargetWidth Z A)) *
              ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (((Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*Z^(q.rightTargetWidth Z A)) *
              ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *

    (hr : a*Z^A ≤ (s.D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀)

        Real.sqrt ((q.C.absNorm : ℝ)*q.D.absNorm)

statement:
theorem joint_first_centered_sector_from_local_joint_targets
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay : ℕ) (ν B lower : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z M A δ a window Ch Ct : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 < a →
      0 ≤ Ch → 0 ≤ Ct → lower ≤ q.leftTargetWidth Z A → lower ≤ q.rightTargetWidth Z A →
      ∀ (t K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*A₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.C.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.D.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.activeWidth Z/2+q.punctureWidth Z ≤
        (s l).activeWidth Z/2+(s l).punctureWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (Z^M) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →

statement:
theorem actual_local_natural_moment
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask ε : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hsSlot : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) :
    ∃ mesh : ℝ, 0 < mesh ∧ mesh ≤ lowLocalMesh ∧ ∃ J : ℕ,
    ∀ (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O), Q ≤ M →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus →
    ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)),
    ∃ ν C : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ mesh) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → height ≤ Z^ν → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) → |t| ≤ Z^ν →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z X₁+Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)
title: actual_local_natural_moment

theorem actual_local_first_original_target_explicit_mesh
    (Wslot:ℝ→ℂ)(aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask upper bplain₁ bplain₂ ε ξ:ℝ)
    (haslot:0< aslot)(hsSlot:Function.support Wslot⊆Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot:ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot)(hbslot:0≤ bslot)
    (ha:0< a)(hlo:a≤1/4)(hhi:1≤ b)(hbΦ:0< bΦ)(hBmask:0≤ Bmask)
    (hupper:0≤ upper)(hε:0<ε)(hξ:0<ξ)
    (hbeta:51/100≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)(hbetaTop:HeckeZeroSupremum.beta≤7/8):
    ∃J:ℕ,∃U Sd St:Finset (ℕ×ℕ),∃Cd Ct:ℝ,0< Cd ∧ 0< Ct ∧
    ∀ηfirst η₀:Character,∀Q:Ideal O,Q≤ M → internalQ Q η₀≠0 → internalQ Q η₀≠⊤ →
      internalQ Q η₀≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
    ∃Cc:ℝ,0< Cc ∧ ∀ᶠZ:ℝ in atTop,1< Z ∧
      ∀(src:Input α)(profile:Profiles a b),
      profile.profile 0=src.W₁ → profile.profile 1=src.W₂ →
      (∀i,|src.hi i|≤ upper) → |src.b₁|≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂|≤ bplain₂ → src.upper≤ upper →
      0< sourceRadius src →
      ∀(θ:α→RayQuotient.Characters M H)(w σ freq:α→ℝ)(height:ℝ),
      CenteredMomentAllocatedRayDictionary.Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq Wslot bslot Z →
      (∀i,0≤ w i) → (∀i,w i≤ meshGuaranteed Bmask ε) → (∀i,lo≤σ i) → (∀i,σ i≤ hi) →
      0≤ height → (∀i,|freq i|≤ height) →
      410/1000≤ Real.logb Z src.X₁ → 410/1000≤ Real.logb Z src.X₂ →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁≤423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂≤423/1000 → (∑i,w i)≤37/1000 →
      src.Y₁=comparisonFirst Z 1 → src.Y₂=comparisonSecond Z 1 src.X₁ src.X₂ →
      ∀s:NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,s.fixedModulus=internalQ Q η₀ →
        s.character=ηfirst → src.η=s.character → s.rowWidth=1 →
        s.characterWidth=Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm:ℝ) →
      energy src.η s.mask 1 src.t src.W₁ src.W₂ src.slots src.toData.coefficient src.P
        src.X₁ src.X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
      (2/volume src.toData)*
        (∑i:FirstSourceOuterIndex src s.puncture 1 Z (actualLowFirstRadius src s.puncture 1 Z Z ξ),
          ‖firstPhysicalValue src s.puncture 1 Z (actualLowFirstRadius src s.puncture 1 Z Z ξ)
            (fun _=> src.t) s.radial.profile (fun _=> logAnnulus) i‖)+
      2*Cd*(plainControl src (profile.profile 0) (profile.profile 1))^2*
        Sd.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℂ) s.radial.profile*Z^(1+ε)+
      2*Ct*(plainControl src (profile.profile 0) (profile.profile 1))^2*
        St.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℂ) s.radial.profile*Z^(1+ε)+
      2*Cc*diagonalControl s.radial.profile*
        (sourceControl U (profile.profile 0)*sourceControl U (profile.profile 1))^2*
        (1+|src.t|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)

theorem first_original_source_remainder (hi : ι → ℝ) (a b ε ξ saving : ℝ)
    (hhi : ∀ i,0 ≤ hi i) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hε : 0 < ε) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∃ Sd St : Finset (ℕ×ℕ), ∃ Cd Ct : ℝ, 0 < Cd ∧ 0 < Ct ∧
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (src : Input ι) (W₁ W₂ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)), src.W₁ = W₁ → src.W₂ = W₂ →
      Function.support (W₁ : ℝ → ℂ) ⊆ Set.Icc a b →
      Function.support (W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) ⊆ Set.Icc a b →
      (∀ i,src.hi i ≤ hi i) → volume src.toData ≤ Z →
      0 < sourceRadius src → sourceRadius src ≤ Z →
    ∀ (m A : O), goodLambda ∣ m → (2:O) ∣ m →
    ∀ (R seed : Ideal O) (Φ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)),
      ‖finiteHeckeEnergy src.η m A src.t (finiteColumns (Fintype.piFinset src.pools))
          (coefficient src R seed) Φ Z-
        CenteredMomentFirstSectorLocalization.retainedEnergy src.η m A src.t
          (finiteColumns (Fintype.piFinset src.pools)) (coefficient src R seed)
          Φ Z (sourceRadius src) Z ξ‖ / volume src.toData ≤
      Cd*(plainControl src W₁ W₂)^2*Sd.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℂ) Φ*Z^(1+ε)+
      Ct*(plainControl src W₁ W₂)^2*St.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℂ) Φ*Z^(1-saving)

statement:
theorem sum_ray_fibers (fallback : First src R seed Kfirst radius)
    (X : Finset (Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H))
    (hzero : ∀ x∈X,(row x).z≠0) (χ ξ : RayCharacter)
    (V P : ℝ) (t : First src R seed Kfirst radius → ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∑ x∈rayPackets X χ ξ,packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ V P t W x) =
      ∑ q∈rayRows fallback X hzero χ ξ,
        ∑ n₁ : q.val.FirstDyadic Kfirst (radius q.val.first q.val.E) (sourceRadius src),
        ∑ n₂ : q.val.SecondDyadic (secondScale fallback K χ ξ q.val n₁)
          (secondScale fallback Radius χ ξ q.val n₁) (secondScale fallback H χ ξ q.val n₁),
        if (⟨q,n₁,n₂⟩ : FiberTarget fallback χ ξ K Radius H side)∈rayTarget fallback X hzero χ ξ
        then fiberValue hs hz₁ hz₂ fallback χ ξ V P t W ⟨q,n₁,n₂⟩ else 0
title: sum_ray_fibers

    (V P : ℝ) (hV : 0< V) (hP : 0< P)
    (t : First src R seed Kfirst radius → ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
    (labels : Finset (FirstSourceOuterIndex src R seed Kfirst radius))
    (rows : (k : First src R seed Kfirst radius) → Blocks src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H k → Finset O)
    (hK : ∀ k∈firstSideSourceLabels labels (firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius)
      (fun _ => sourceRadius src) side,0< K k)
    (hrows : ∀ k∈firstSideSourceLabels labels (firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius)
      (fun _ => sourceRadius src) side,∀ b z,z∈rows k b → z≠0) :
    (∑ k∈firstSideSourceLabels labels (firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius)
      (fun _ => sourceRadius src) side,
      ‖actualSecondRowBlocks (parent src R seed Kfirst radius side k) (t k)
        (columns src R seed Kfirst radius side k) (beta src R seed Kfirst radius side k)
        W (K k) (Radius k) (H k) (rows k)‖/(V*P)) ≤
      ∑ x∈packets src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H labels rows,
        packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ V P t W x

statement:
theorem sum_packets {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (labels : Finset (FirstSourceOuterIndex src R seed Kfirst radius))
    (rows : (k : First src R seed Kfirst radius) → Blocks src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H k → Finset O)
    (f : Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H → A) :
    (∑ x ∈ packets src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H labels rows,f x) =
      ∑ k ∈ firstSideSourceLabels labels (firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius)
        (fun _ => sourceRadius src) side,
        ∑ b : Blocks src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H k, ∑ z ∈ rows k b,f ⟨k,b,z⟩
title: sum_packets

statement:
theorem first_sideEnergy_from_supported_normalized
    (labels : Finset Λ) (q : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι) (ref : FirstJointLabel ι)
    (H : Λ → ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ I, (q l).data.beta I ≠ 0 → (I.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H l)
    (left : Bool) (t : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → ℝ)
    (W : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
    (K : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → ℝ)
    (V Z A C loss : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V) (hZ : 1 < Z)
    (hbound : (∑ k ∈ firstSideSourceLabels labels q H left,
      ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (t k) (W k) (K k)/V) ≤
      C*Z^(ref.radicalWidth Z+A-2*ref.sideWidth left Z+ref.activeWidth Z+
        ref.punctureWidth Z+ref.sideAllowance left Z+loss)) :
    (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
      ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (t k) (W k) (K k)) ≤
      (V/(ref.sideCommon left).absNorm : ℝ)*
        (C*Z^(ref.sideTargetWidth left Z A+loss))
title: first_sideEnergy_from_supported_normalized

    (decay Ncap : ℕ) (ν F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂ D B L Cr Amin Amax J : ℝ)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) (hJ : 0 ≤ J) :
    ∃ degree : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O),
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Ncap → (∀ i, s.M i ≤ F) → s.upper ≤ U → s.b₁ ≤ b₁ → s.b₂ ≤ b₂ →

    ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,

theorem joint_first_variable_blocks_from_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Λ → Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ) (η : Λ → ℂ),
      (∀ l, ∀ z ∈ rows l, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i : (s l).SourceIndex,
        ‖η l * (s l).sourceWeight (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l) i‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows l, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows k.1,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ E₁ → 0 ≤ E₂ →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₁ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₂ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) * η l *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) (rows l) W V (K l) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ ≤
          C * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂)
title: joint_first_variable_blocks_from_common_energy

theorem joint_first_variable_centered_sector_from_local_joint_targets
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay : ℕ) (ν B lower : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Λ → Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z M A δ a window Ch Ct : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 < a →
      0 ≤ Ch → 0 ≤ Ct → lower ≤ q.leftTargetWidth Z A → lower ≤ q.rightTargetWidth Z A →
      ∀ (t K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ l, ∀ z ∈ rows l, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*A₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.C.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.D.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.activeWidth Z/2+q.punctureWidth Z ≤
        (s l).activeWidth Z/2+(s l).punctureWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (Z^M) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows l, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows k.1,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(q.leftTargetWidth Z A))) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(q.rightTargetWidth Z A))) →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ct*Z^B) →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ct*Z^B) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) (rows l) W V (Z^M) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ / Z^A ≤
          C * (Ch+Ct) * (Real.exp window/a) * Z^(M+δ)

    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows l,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (E₁ E₂ : ℝ) (hE₁ : 0 ≤ E₁) (hE₂ : 0 ≤ E₂)
    (hleft : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,

statement:
theorem joint_first_window_abs_bound {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
    (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
    (t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ : Λ → ℝ)
    (hX₁ : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < X₁ l) (hX₂ : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < X₂ l) (θ : ℝ)
    (V₁ : ℝ → ℂ) (hV₁c : HasCompactSupport V₁) (hV₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₁)
    (V₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport V₂) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₂)
    (U : Λ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (K : Λ → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < K l)
    (hU : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z : O, 0 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (E₁ E₂ : ℝ) (hE₁ : 0 ≤ E₁) (hE₂ : 0 ≤ E₂)
    (hleft : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).leftEnergy (t₁ l+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U l) (K l)) ≤
        E₁*(1+‖w‖)^(2*J₁))
    (hright : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).rightEnergy (t₂ l+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) (U l) (K l)) ≤
        E₂*(1+‖w‖)^(2*J₂)) :
    (∑ l ∈ labels, ∑ z ∈ rows,
      ‖(s l).leftWindowValue (t₁ l) θ (X₁ l) V₁ z‖ *
      ‖(s l).rightWindowValue (t₂ l) θ (X₂ l) V₂ z‖) ≤
      (Real.sqrt E₁ * jointColumnMoment V₁ hV₁c hV₁s J₁) *
      (Real.sqrt E₂ * jointColumnMoment (fun x => star (V₂ x))
        (conjugate_compact V₂ hV₂c) (conjugate_smooth V₂ hV₂s) J₂)

statement:
theorem exists_global_original_source_bins
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [Nonempty Slot] (e : ℝ) (he : 0 < e)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) :
    ∃ I : ℕ, 0 < I ∧ ∀ (η η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O)
      (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)}) (hQM : Q ≤ M) (hQη₀ : Q ≤ η₀.modulus)
      (T : ℝ), 2 < T →
    ∃ bin : NonzeroElement → Option (Fin (I+1) × Fin (I+1)),
      (∀ w,bin w = none ↔ FixedInducingRow η Q fixedBadMask 1 w.val) ∧
      (∀ w b,bin w = some b → 1 ≤ b.1.val ∧
        51/100 ≤ 51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ) ∧

statement:
theorem actual_literal_high_bins_target
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot : ℝ) (haslot : 0 < aslot)
    (hWslot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot)
    (hslotSupport : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)
    (BR e σmin σmax τdetector : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hBR : 0 ≤ BR) (he : 0 < e) (hecap : e ≤ highLocalBinCap BR (Fintype.card Slot))
    (hτdetector : 0 < τdetector)
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂plain : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂plain) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (hlo : ∀ j,0 < lo j)
    (Mslot upper : ℝ) (hMslot : 0 ≤ Mslot)
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) :
    ∃ τ ν C : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧ τ < τdetector ∧
      4*τ < highLocalEpsilon BR (Fintype.card Slot)/16 ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 2 ≤ Z ∧ 2 < Z^τ ∧
      ∀ (θ : Slot → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : Slot → ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ lowLocalMesh) →
      (∀ i,σmin ≤ σ i ∧ σ i ≤ σmax) → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ Z^ν) →
      ∀ (src : Input Slot),
      CenteredMomentAllocatedRayDictionary.Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq Wslot bslot Z →
      src.η = η → src.W₁ = W₁ → src.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) → src.upper ≤ upper →
      (∀ i,src.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i,src.hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) → |src.b₁| ≤ b₁ → |src.b₂| ≤ b₂plain →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.Y₁ ≤ 1 → Real.logb Z src.Y₂ ≤ 1 →
      0 < sourceRadius src →
      0 ≤ Real.logb Z (CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume src.toData) →
      Real.logb Z (CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume src.toData) ≤ 883/1000 →
      ∀ (R : Ideal O),R ≠ 0 → (R.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BR →
      ∀ (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0=0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0=0),
      let radius

      lowLocalTiny/2+highLocalDmax BR*highLocalProductLoss BR N ≤ lowLocalTiny

statement:
theorem paired_rows (F : FirstSidePresentation η) (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot)
    (hs : s.parent = F.sourceParent) (hp : s.puncture ≠ 0) (z : O) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    F.leftPuncture s ≠ 0 ∧ F.rightPuncture s ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ parentL parentR : JointParentLabel η,
    ∃ NL : NaturalRow parentL.val (F.row s z hz).val,
    ∃ NR : NaturalRow parentR.val (F.row s z hz).val,
      ∀ (t : ℝ) (I : Ideal O),
        (rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent s.leftRay)
          (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
          s.toKernelLabel.frequency z t I =
        rowWeight parentL.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (F.leftPuncture s)) 1 (F.row s z hz).val t I) ∧
        (rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent (s.rightRay⁻¹))
          (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
          s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) t I =
        rowWeight parentR.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (F.rightPuncture s)) 1 (F.row s z hz).val t I)
title: paired_rows

lemma annular_slot_height_shift (η : Character) (m A z : O)
    (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (hS : ∀ I ∈ S, I ≠ 0)
    (c : Ideal O → ℂ) (W : ℝ → ℂ) (P σ freq t : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    normalizedSlot η m A z S
      (fun I => c I * HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight W P σ (freq-t) I) t P =
    (P : ℂ)^(Complex.I*t) * normalizedSlot η m A z S
      (fun I => c I * HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight W P σ freq I) 0 P

statement:
lemma independent_energy_le_diagonal_energies {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (η : Character) (m A : O) (W₁ W₂ Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Set.Iic b₁) (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Set.Iic b₂)
    (S : α → Finset (Ideal O)) (hS : ∀ i I, I ∈ S i → I ≠ 0)
    (c : α → Ideal O → ℂ) (P σ freq : α → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i, 0 < P i)
    (t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂)
    (keep : O → Prop) (Φ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hΦ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (Φ x).re) :
    independentPlainEnergy η m A W₁ W₂ S
      (fun i I => c i I * HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (P i) (σ i) (freq i) I)
      P t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ keep Φ K ≤
    energy η m A t₁ W₁ W₁ S
      (fun i I => c i I * HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (P i) (σ i) (freq i-t₁) I)
      P X₁ X₁ keep Φ K +
    energy η m A t₂ W₂ W₂ S
      (fun i I => c i I * HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (P i) (σ i) (freq i-t₂) I)
      P X₂ X₂ keep Φ K

statement:
theorem actual_local_independent_plain_moment
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask ε : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hsSlot : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
    (hQzero : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0) (hQtop : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤)
    (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)})
    (hQη : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus)
    (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (hWradial : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (Wradial x).re) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t₁ t₂ height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ meshGuaranteed Bmask ε) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      2*Real.logb Z X₁+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
      2*Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →
      independentPlainEnergy s.character s.mask 1 (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i => Z^(w i)) t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t₁|+|t₂|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)
title: actual_local_independent_plain_moment

theorem whole_kernel_joint_estimate (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i) (decay J : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {κ : Type*} {α β : κ → Type*}
      (rows : Finset κ) (S : (k : κ) → Finset (α k)) (T : (k : κ) → Finset (β k))
      (c : (k : κ) → α k → ℂ) (d : (k : κ) → β k → ℂ)
      (u : (k : κ) → α k → ℝ) (v : (k : κ) → β k → ℝ)
      (R ρ x : κ → ℝ) (η : κ → ℂ), (∀ k, 0 < R k) →
      (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖η k‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖V 0 (ρ k)‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (x k)‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ E : ℝ,
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ rows, ‖leftColumn (S k) (c k) (V 2) (u k) t‖*
        ‖rightColumn (T k) (d k) (V 3) (v k) t‖) ≤ E*(1+‖t‖)^J) →
      ‖∑ k ∈ rows, (((1+R k)^decay : ℝ):ℂ)*η k*
        (∑ i ∈ S k, ∑ j ∈ T k, (c k i*star (d k j))*
          wholeKernel W V (R k) (ρ k) (x k) (u k i) (v k j))‖ ≤ C*E

statement:
theorem joint_second_kernel_bin_partition [Fintype κ]
    (labels : Finset Λ) (s : Λ → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι)
    (Ds : Λ → Finset (Ideal O)) (rows : Λ → Finset O)
    (bin : Λ → O → κ) (t K R : Λ → ℝ) (n : Λ → Fin 4 → ℤ)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ) (weight : Λ → Ideal O → ℂ) :
    (∑ l ∈ labels, ∑ D ∈ Ds l, ∑ z ∈ rows l,

statement:
lemma allocated_low_pair {Z Bmask radial a b : ℝ} (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial)
    (hunit : s.puncture = 1) (low : O → Prop)
    (D : Ideal O) (alloc : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (α ⊕ Fin 2)))
    (ha : 0 < a) (p : Profiles a b) (pool : α → Finset (Ideal O))
    (β : α → Ideal O → ℂ) (P : α → ℝ) (v X₁ X₂ : ℝ)
    (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂) (F₁ F₂ : Finset (Ideal O)) (J : Finset α) :
    allocatedEnergy s.character (restrictedLowRadial s.radial low) D alloc
      (sourcePlain a b ha (p.profile 0) (p.support 0))
      (sourcePlain a b ha (p.profile 1) (p.support 1)) pool β P v X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂ F₁ F₂ J =
    energy s.character s.mask 1 0
      ((pair D alloc ha p v X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂).profile 0)
      ((pair D alloc ha p v X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂).profile 1)
      (fun i : ↥(liveIndices D alloc \ J) => pool i)
      (fun i : ↥(liveIndices D alloc \ J) => CenteredMomentCommonMaskEnergy.heightCoefficient (β i) v)
      (fun i : ↥(liveIndices D alloc \ J) => P i)
      (scale D alloc X₁ 0 F₁) (scale D alloc X₂ 1 F₂)
      (fun z => s.radial.keep z ∧ low z) s.radial.profile s.radial.scale

    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b lo hi Mslot upper bplain₁ bplain₂ BRmask : ℝ)

    (hamp : ξamp+reserve ≤ lowLocalTiny) (hξsecond : 0 ≤ ξsecond)
    (hξsecondCap : ξsecond ≤ lowLocalTiny) :
    ∃ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧
    ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)},
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,

      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →

    ∀ (Rmask seed : Ideal O), Rmask ≠ 0 → (Rmask.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BRmask →

    (loInput hiInput : α → ℝ) (hloInput : ∀ i,0 < loInput i)
    (ηfirst : Character) (profile : Profiles a b) (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))

    (LfirstRad Crfirst : ℝ) (hLfirstRad : 0 ≤ LfirstRad) (hCrfirst : 0 < Crfirst) :
    ∃ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧
    ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)},
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ lowLocalMesh) →
      (∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i,σ i ≤ hi) →
      0 ≤ height → height ≤ Z^ν → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (src : Input α), Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq W bslot Z →

      (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) → src.upper ≤ upper →
      |src.b₁| ≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂| ≤ bplain₂ → src.η = ηfirst →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →

      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁+Real.logb Z src.X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (Rmask seed : Ideal O), Rmask ≠ 0 → (Rmask.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BRmask →

    ∀ (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0 = 0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0 = 0), 0 < sourceRadius src →
    ∀ Kfirst : ℝ, 0 < Kfirst →
    ∀ radius : (v : Labels src Rmask seed) → Finset (CommonIndex v.val.1 v.val.2) → ℝ,

statement:
theorem actual_common_second_paired_values
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (src : Input ι) (R seed C₁ L₁ : Ideal O) (hC₁ : Supported C₁)
    (p : ActiveLabel (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
      (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁))
    (η : Character) (U : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2))
    (family : RayCharacter → Character)
    (hfamily : Family η p.val.1 p.val.2 (lowActiveLeftSupported p) (lowActiveRightSupported p) U family)
    (χL χR : RayCharacter) (vL vR HL HR : ℝ) (hHL : 0 < HL) (hHR : 0 < HR)
    (L : Ideal O) (rL rR : Radial) (rows : Finset O)
    (hkeepL : ∀ z ∈ rows,rL.keep z) (hkeepR : ∀ z ∈ rows,rR.keep (-z))
    (hmajorL : ∀ z ∈ rows,1 ≤ (rL.profile (‖ConcreteTraceCRT.eisEmbedding z‖^2/rL.scale)).re)
    (hmajorR : ∀ z ∈ rows,1 ≤ (rR.profile (‖ConcreteTraceCRT.eisEmbedding (-z)‖^2/rR.scale)).re) :
    (∑ z ∈ rows,
      ‖secondChildValue η vL
        (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
        (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) p.val.1 (lowActiveLeftSupported p)
        (commonFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2*nonunitFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2 U)
        L χL z HL‖ *
      ‖secondChildValue η vR
        (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
        (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) p.val.2 (lowActiveRightSupported p)
        (commonFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2*nonunitFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2 U)
        L χR (-z) HR‖) ≤
      (volume src.toData/Real.sqrt (HL*HR))*
        (Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy (withHeight src (family χL) vL) rL (C₁*p.val.1)
          ((supported_mul_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hC₁,lowActiveLeftSupported p⟩) R seed L)*
         Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy (withHeight src (family χR) vR) rR (C₁*p.val.2)
          ((supported_mul_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hC₁,lowActiveRightSupported p⟩) R seed L))
title: actual_common_second_paired_values

lemma activePhysicalRows_projected_majorant (η : Character) (t : ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (β : Ideal O → ℂ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K R H V P : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hV : 0 < V) (hP : 0 < P)
    (q : ActiveBlocks S β K R H) (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows,z ≠ 0) :
    ‖activePhysicalRows η t S β W K R H q rows‖/(V*P) ≤
      ∑ L ∈ actualSecondProjectors S β K R H q, ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ ξ : RayCharacter,
        ‖(UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ)‖*
          ‖pairCoeff (phaseTable (primaryGenerator q.1.1.val.1) (primaryGenerator q.1.1.val.2)) χ ξ‖*
          (secondPrecountFactor V P q.1.1.val.1 q.1.1.val.2 q.1.2 K (fun i => (q.2 i : ℤ))*
            ∑ z ∈ rows, ‖(projectedSecondKernelLabel η (activeSource S β) β q.1.1.val.1 q.1.1.val.2
              (commonLabels_supported (activeSource S β) _ _ q.1.1.property).1
              (commonLabels_supported (activeSource S β) _ _ q.1.1.property).2
              (commonLabels_data _ _ _ _ q.1.1.property).2.2 q.1.2 L χ ξ).kernelRow t z W K R
                (fun i => (q.2 i : ℤ))‖)

theorem commonEnergy_actual_second_bins {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (s : CenteredMomentFirstAmplificationChoice.OriginalData ι) (C : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C)
    (η : Character) (t : ℝ) (L : Ideal O) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K T Z ξ H : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K)
    (hH : ∀ I ∈ commonSecondColumns s C hC,commonSecondBeta s C L I ≠ 0 → (I.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H)
    (bin : ActiveBlocks (commonSecondColumns s C hC) (commonSecondBeta s C L)
      K (frequencyRadius T Z ξ) H → O → κ) :
    CenteredMomentFirstPhysicalSource.commonEnergy s C hC η t L W K =
      ((K : ℂ)*paperRadialFourier W 0)*
        CenteredMomentSourceSecondZeroEnergy.sourceSecondZero (commonSecondColumns s C hC) (commonSecondBeta s C L) η t +
      (∑ b : κ,actualSecondRowBlocks η t (commonSecondColumns s C hC) (commonSecondBeta s C L)
        W K (frequencyRadius T Z ξ) H (fun q =>
          (retainedRows (frequencyRadius T Z ξ)
            (commonFrequencyGenerator q.1.1.val.1 q.1.1.val.2*
              nonunitFrequencyGenerator q.1.1.val.1 q.1.1.val.2 q.1.2)).filter (fun z => bin q z = b))) +
      CenteredMomentSupportedTailAggregate.secondDiscardedEnergy η t (commonSecondColumns s C hC) (commonSecondBeta s C L)
        W K T Z ξ
title: commonEnergy_actual_second_bins

theorem low_actual_precount_eq (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (hD : Supported D)
    (U : Finset (CommonIndex C D)) (Z A c d R E Mparent omega primeCount K : ℝ)
    (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) (hZ : 1 < Z) (hp : 0 < primeCount)
    (hK : K = Z^(2*A-c-d+R+E-Mparent+max (d-c) 0+6*(3/500)+omega)) :
    secondPrecountFactor (Z^(A-c)) primeCount C D U K n =
      (Z^(3/500 : ℝ)/primeCount)*
        Z^(A-min c d+R+E-Mparent+5*(3/500)+
          Real.logb Z (normValue (commonFrequencyGenerator C D))-
          Real.logb Z ((∏ P ∈ U,P.val).absNorm : ℝ)-
          (Real.logb Z (C.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z (D.absNorm : ℝ))/2+omega)

theorem eventually_supported_low_gate
    (η₀ : Character) (radial ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (Bmask d : ℝ) (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial),
      s.width+Bmask+ξ ≤ d →
      ∀ (η : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
        (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀)
        (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)}),
      ∀ (w : NonzeroElement)
        (hex : ¬FixedInducingRow η (internalQ Q η₀) fixedBadMask 1 w.val),
      ∀ (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
        (R : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (z : O) (hz : (supportedNaturalState s).radial.keep z),
      (∀ I : Ideal O,
        idealCoeff (excluded (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz.1)).character s.puncture) I =
          idealCoeff (excluded N.character R) I) →
      ∀ (τ e a : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      zeroMaximum
          (fun label => (momentData (jointRelativeParent η
            (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀)) label)).character w)
          (jointRelativeMoment_nonprincipal η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀))
            (internalQ Q η₀) hQ72
            (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀) (internalQ Q η₀)
              (inf_le_left.trans hQM) (fun _ => inf_le_right)) w hex)
          (3*(k+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ) < a+2*e →
      NaturalLowGate M H hH (supportedNaturalState s) η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e a k z hz

theorem joint_population_count (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (u : Oˣ) (W : Finset O) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel),

      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, v.row u ∈ W) →
      ∀ X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ Yw Yr : ℝ,
      0 < X₁ → 0 < Y₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 < Y₂ → 0 ≤ Yw → 0 ≤ Yr →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ X₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Y₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ X₂ ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Y₂) →

      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (v.row u)) : ℝ) ≤ Yr) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K * W.card * Yr * X₁^a * Y₁^a * X₂^a * Y₂^a * (Yr*Yw)^(5*ε)

statement:
theorem actual_joint_relative_density {SlotLabel : Type*} [Fintype SlotLabel]
    (η : Character) (ν : SlotLabel → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : Q ≤ η.modulus) (hQν : ∀ j, Q ≤ (ν j).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loss : ℝ) (hlosspos : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → ∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ F : Finset FreeRow,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rowNorm u ≤ Y ∧
          ∃ (R : JointRelativeLabel η SlotLabel → Ideal O) (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
          jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η ν Q hQ72 hQν R hR
            p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss)) ∧
      (∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        ∀ F : Finset ProbePhysical.NonzeroFrequency,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rawFrequencyNorm u ≤ Y ∧
          ∃ (R : JointRelativeLabel η SlotLabel → Ideal O) (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
          jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η ν Q hQ72 hQν R hR p.lower p.upper p.height u) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss))
title: actual_joint_relative_density

statement:
theorem actual_retained_buffered_data
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)

        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency z t₁ I =

        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) t₂ I =
        rowWeight parentR.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureR) 1 w.val t₂ I) →

      s.input.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.input.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.input.P i ∧ s.input.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NL.character punctureL) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NR.character punctureR) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →

      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (∀ i, 2*(|Real.log (alo i)|+|Real.log (bhi i)|)+1 ≤ Real.log (s.input.P i)) →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →

      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        s.fullFiberValue t₁ t₂ z q =

        d*DL.length ≤ s.fullLeftLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        d*DR.length ≤ s.fullRightLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧

theorem actual_complete_retained_fiber_mass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (Bcap loss : ℝ) (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hloss : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel ι), (∀ i, s.input.lo i = lo i) →
      (∀ i, s.input.hi i = hi i) →
      ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap →
      ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap →
      ∀ (Ds : Finset (Ideal O)),
      (∀ L ∈ Ds, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap) →
      ∀ (t₁ t₂ H₁ H₂ a : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < H₁ → 0 < H₂ →
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume s.input.toData/
        ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H₁ →
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume s.input.toData/
        ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H₂ →
      s.fullFiberMass Ds t₁ t₂ H₁ H₂ ≤
        C*Z^loss*((secondProfileScalar s.input.toData)^2*commonSourceProfile s.input/a)

                secondAllocationScalar (s.leftData B t₁) (s.rightData F t₂) L a b)

statement:
theorem actual_retained_buffered_short_gates
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parentL parentR : JointParentLabel η)
        (NL : NaturalRow parentL.val w.val) (NR : NaturalRow parentR.val w.val)
        (punctureL punctureR : Ideal O) (hpunctureL : punctureL ≠ 0) (hpunctureR : punctureR ≠ 0)
        (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : Finset (Ideal O)) (z : O) (t₁ t₂ Z d : ℝ)
        (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (alo bhi : ι → ℝ)
        (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.input.W₁ = W₁ → s.input.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.input.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.input.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, I ∈ s.input.slots i → s.input.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.input.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent s.leftRay)
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency z t₁ I =
        rowWeight parentL.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureL) 1 w.val t₁ I) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent (s.rightRay⁻¹))
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) t₂ I =
        rowWeight parentR.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureR) 1 w.val t₂ I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.input.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.input.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.input.P i ∧ s.input.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NL.character punctureL) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NR.character punctureR) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t₁|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ → |t₂|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      ∀ q ∈ s.liveFullRetainedFiber Ds t₁ t₂ z,
      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        s.fullFiberValue t₁ t₂ z q =
          ‖DL.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖*‖DR.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*DL.length ≤ s.fullLeftLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        d*DR.length ≤ s.fullRightLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        DL.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        DR.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        (∀ j : DL.slots, (Z^d)^(DL.data.r j) = s.input.P j.val) ∧
        (∀ j : DR.slots, (Z^d)^(DR.data.r j) = s.input.P j.val) ∧
        (∀ j, DL.data.σ j = 0 ∧ DL.data.v j = 0) ∧ DL.data.t = t₁ ∧ DL.data.bin = bin ∧
        (∀ j, DR.data.σ j = 0 ∧ DR.data.v j = 0) ∧ DR.data.t = t₂ ∧ DR.data.bin = bin

      (A c d R e M a ω Lc H εH ξ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ H → H ≤ Z^(A+εH) → (C₁.absNorm : ℝ) = Z^c →

        (normValue (commonFrequencyGenerator C₂ D₂ * nonunitFrequencyGenerator C₂ D₂ U * h)) ≠ 0 →
      normValue (jointLeftRow C₁ D₁ C₂ D₂ E u U h) ≤
        Z^(M-R-max (c-d) 0+Lc-6*a+ε)

theorem joint_second_kernel_from_local_retained_absolute
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ) (ν B target : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :

      (∀ k ∈ labels, ‖weight k‖ ≤ 1) → ∀ Z scale Ch Ct : ℝ,

      (∀ θ u v : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖v‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ch*Z^target) →

        ‖(((1+SecondKernelLabel.kernelScale (n k))^decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *

theorem joint_second_phase_source_pair {α : Type*} (ι κ : α → Type*)
    [∀ ℓ, Fintype (ι ℓ)] [∀ ℓ, Fintype (κ ℓ)]
    [∀ ℓ, DecidableEq (ι ℓ)] [∀ ℓ, DecidableEq (κ ℓ)]
    (Λ : Finset α) (weight : α → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ ℓ ∈ Λ, 0 ≤ weight ℓ)
    (s : ∀ ℓ, Data (ι ℓ)) (v : ∀ ℓ, Data (κ ℓ)) (C D : α → Ideal O)
    (hC : ∀ ℓ, Supported (C ℓ)) (hD : ∀ ℓ, Supported (D ℓ))
    (hCD : ∀ ℓ, CompletedGauss.primeSupport (C ℓ) = CompletedGauss.primeSupport (D ℓ))
    (U : ∀ ℓ, Finset (CenteredMomentCanonicalFirst.CommonIndex (C ℓ) (D ℓ)))
    (R : α → ℝ) (L : α → Ideal O) (hL : ∀ ℓ, Squarefree (L ℓ)) (z : α → O) :
    (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, weight ℓ *
      ‖secondBlockRowPhase (C ℓ) (D ℓ) (hC ℓ) (hD ℓ) (U ℓ) (R ℓ) (z ℓ) *
        secondMaskedValue (s ℓ).toSource (L ℓ) (z ℓ) *
        star (secondMaskedValue (v ℓ).toSource (L ℓ) (-(z ℓ)))‖) ≤
    ∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, weight ℓ * secondRetainedPairBound (s ℓ) (v ℓ) (L ℓ) (z ℓ) (-(z ℓ))

theorem actual_enlarged_secondBlock_precount (η : Character) (t : ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (β : Ideal O → ℂ)
    (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (hD : Supported D)
    (hCD : primeSupport C = primeSupport D) (U : Finset (CommonIndex C D))
    (R : ℝ) (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ)
    (Z A c d R₁ E₁ M a ω : ℝ) (hZ : 1 < Z) :
    ‖physicalBlock η t S β C D hC hD U R rows W
      (Z^(2*A-c-d+R₁+E₁-M+max (d-c) 0+6*a+ω)) n‖/(Z^(A-c)*Z^a) =
      Z^(A-min c d+R₁+E₁-M+5*a+ω+
        Real.logb Z (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {commonFrequencyGenerator C D}) : ℝ)-
        Real.logb Z ((∏ Q ∈ U, Q.val).absNorm : ℝ)-
        (Real.logb Z (C.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z (D.absNorm : ℝ))/2) *
        (‖actualSecondChildren η t S β C D hC hD U R rows W
          (Z^(2*A-c-d+R₁+E₁-M+max (d-c) 0+6*a+ω)) n‖/
          Real.sqrt (dyadicScale (n 2)*dyadicScale (n 3)))

        W K Tsec Z ξ H +
      secondDiscardedEnergy τ t (commonSecondColumns s C hC) (commonSecondBeta s C L)
        W K Tsec Z ξ

    (Λ : Finset α) (s : α → OriginalData ι) (C L : α → Ideal O)

        secondDiscardedEnergy (τ ℓ) (t ℓ) (commonSecondColumns (s ℓ) (C ℓ) (hC ℓ))

statement:
theorem secondLogCost_le_capped_sectors (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot)
    (Z g t b eg et eb : ℝ) (hZ : 1 < Z) (heg : 0 ≤ eg) (heb : 0 ≤ eb)
    (hg : Real.logb Z ((Ideal.span {commonFrequencyGenerator s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ g+eg)
    (ht : t-et ≤ Real.logb Z ((∏ Q ∈ s.partition, Q.val).absNorm : ℝ))
    (hb : b-eb ≤ (Real.logb Z (s.second.val.1.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z (s.second.val.2.absNorm : ℝ))/2) :
    min g b ≤ b ∧ s.secondLogCost Z ≤ min g b-t-b+(eg+et+eb)
title: secondLogCost_le_capped_sectors

statement:
theorem actual_second_scalar_mass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (J K : Finset ι) (s : Data J) (v : Data K),
      (∀ i : J, s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i : J, s.hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ i : K, v.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i : K, v.hi i = hi i) →
      ∀ Ds : Finset (Ideal O),
      (∀ L ∈ Ds, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∑ L ∈ Ds, ‖(UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ)‖ *
        ∑ a ∈ s.toSource.active L, ∑ b ∈ v.toSource.active L,
          secondAllocationScalar s v L a b) ≤
        C*Z^δ*(secondProfileScalar s*secondProfileScalar v)
title: actual_second_scalar_mass

theorem rawRow_eq_scaled (s : SecondKernelLabel) (t : ℝ) (z : O)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K R : ℝ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) :
    secondBlockRowPhase s.C s.D s.hC s.hD s.U R z *
      (∑ I : s.LeftIndex, ∑ J : s.RightIndex,
        (secondBlockChildCoefficient s.parent t s.columns s.beta s.C s.hC s.frequency
            s.projector s.leftRay z I *
          star (secondBlockChildCoefficient s.parent t s.columns s.beta s.D s.hD s.frequency
            s.projector (s.rightRay⁻¹) (-z) J)) *
          secondBlockKernel s.C s.D s.U W K n z I J) =
      (Real.sqrt (dyadicScale (n 2)*dyadicScale (n 3)) : ℂ) *
        s.kernelRow t z W K R n

statement:
theorem joint_second_projector_kernel_from_cutoff
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ) (ν B target : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (labels : Finset α) (s : α → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O))
        (t K R : α → ℝ) (n : α → Fin 4 → ℤ) (z : α → O) (weight : α → ℂ),
      (∀ k ∈ labels, ‖weight k‖ ≤ 1) → ∀ Z scale Ch Ct : ℝ,
      1 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ scale → 0 ≤ Ch → 0 ≤ Ct →
      (∀ θ u v : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖v‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ch*Z^target) →
      (∀ θ u v : ℝ,
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ct*Z^B) →

    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧

      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : J ℓ, (s ℓ).hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : L ℓ, (v ℓ).lo i = lo i) →
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : L ℓ, (v ℓ).hi i = hi i) →
      ∀ Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O),
      (∀ ℓ ∈ Λ, ∀ D ∈ Ds ℓ, (moebius D : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
